annotations.title: Check whether up to 10 package names exist on npm, PyPI or crates.io, with known OSV.dev advisories

description: Checks up to 10 npm, PyPI or crates names: listed, version, licence, OSV.dev advisories. US$0.005 per call; POST names. 10 free calls a day per IP, resetting at midnight UTC. Costs US$0.005 per call in USDC via x402 (Base), charged when the call answers below 400 (a no-match or not-found result is charged too); a bad request is refused unpaid. Pay by putting an x402 payment payload in _meta["x402/payment"]. Without one it uses the free trial (10 calls a day per address), then returns the payment requirements. Docs: https://vehcdj664efetfrsolne5umanq.srv.us/docs/check-packages

packages.description: 1 to 10 packages to look up. Each is { ecosystem, name, version? }; ecosystem is npm, pypi or crates (crates.io).

name.description: Package name as you would install it (npm names may be scoped: @scope/name).

version.description: Optional: the version you will install (e.g. a pinned 4.17.20). Advisories are then listed for this version; without it, for the latest.
